entry.title: Swallow's Nest

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Two inspected aerial pictures show the stepped limestone hall, eastern round tower, balcony and four crown spires. Cached exact building outline and standard viewer PMTiles set orientation/location. Reconstructed terrace6.4m above the working anchor sample clears the coarse hillside; bounded foundations seat it against the sampled ground. Exact cliff edge and balcony clearances remain approximate. Anchor 34.128585443,44.430632946; heading 0.347692146382; standard PMTiles datum 21.217927594329787m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. The former smooth support is replaced by a faceted weathered-limestone apron beneath the immediate terrace. Rock apron dimensions are approximate. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
